name: Feed steward
design: Short broad round-bellied adult male Yautja, sandy speckled hide, broad aged brow and one shortened upper mandible tip while all four arms are present, short thick untied scalp tendrils. Oat-colored rolled-sleeve linen tunic, dark russet waist apron with stitched pockets, simple belt. Holds a small handled feed pail down beside right leg; left hand holds a shallow scoop close to belly. Civilian bulky friendly working silhouette.
